sentences.text: On 1.27, you can create a Secret directly with kubectl using a command such as `kubectl create secret generic test-secret --from-literal='username=my-app' --from-literal='password=39528$vdg7Jb'`.

On 1.31, you can also create a Secret directly with kubectl using a similar command, for example `kubectl create secret generic test-secret --from-literal='username=my-app' --from-literal='password=39528$vdg7Jb'`.
